# Horizon-14 auxiliary iid decision model: 85th exact optimal affine interval

**2026-10-25; author-level exact finite-model proof.** This is not independent Driver review, a native EM CLAIM/Result, a Lean theorem, or a theorem for native BRC–Shor/X6/Heartbeat dynamics.

## Statement and predecessor

Consider all ordered-history-adaptive randomized sequential tests of length at most 14 with observations 0,1,2 and distributions P=(1/8,1/24,5/6), Q=(1/12,1/12,5/6). Write eP=P(decide Q), eQ=Q(decide P), tP=E_P T, tQ=E_Q T. Let V14(alpha)=min max(tP,tQ) subject to eP,eQ<=alpha. All historical orderings are in the admissible policy class; they are not reduced to a count-only subclass.

Freeze the author-level stage84 endpoint of commit dd8d3a05d2fde3d318d16591eff949fc2dd58ee9: alpha84=5172036451545515543/14900301753911083008; V84=24500207606836313729/1862537719238885376; immediate-Q probability at balancing state B=(12,0,1) is s84=22822170061354427/41779200000000000. Stage84 A84=(7,4,0) now stops P, A83=(8,4,4) stops Q, A82=(9,7,2) stops P, A81=(11,3,3) stops Q; all earlier selected actions are in the complete frozen table of derive85.py.

**Exact theorem:** for every real 0<=delta<=eta85=478690625/1616786214617088,

V14(alpha84+delta) = V84 - (347184/79)*delta.

The sharp right endpoint for this Bellman support line is

alpha85=5172040863158315543/14900301753911083008,

V14(alpha85)=24497784123642713729/1862537719238885376.

"Sharp" concerns termination of this support line, not any impossibility of later better affine pieces.

## Bellman dual lower bound (full 680-state certificate)

The count state (n,a,b) has a zeroes and b ones. The likelihood ratio is Q/P=2^(a+b)/3^a. Although prefixes retain distinct order/provenance for the primal, identical counts have identical conditional laws and likelihood ratio, so a Bellman lower bound on counts applies to all ordered-history-adaptive tests.

Use K85=180792/79, lambdaQ=K85, lambdaP=72+8*K85/9=166392/79 and Gamma85=lambdaP+lambdaQ=347184/79. In P-normalization, actions cost stop-P=lambdaQ*(Q/P), stop-Q=lambdaP, and continue=1+sum_i P_i*D(child_i) when n<14. For the frozen action table, selecting continue at A85=(11,5,1) and B, exact backwards evaluation of every alternative yields: 680 count states, 1240 nonselected action comparisons, 1238 strictly positive gaps, zero negative gaps, and exactly two equalities, A85 continue vs stop P and B continue vs stop Q. The smallest strictly positive gap is 5/474. The root is

Droot=13317150254418373665865/8655322342345408512
     =V84+Gamma85*alpha84.

For any admissible ordered-history policy, the Bellman recursion gives Droot<=tP+lambdaP*eP+lambdaQ*eQ<=max(tP,tQ)+Gamma85*alpha, a global affine lower bound at each permitted alpha. The complete rational recursion is in derive85.py; no floating tolerance appears.

## Ordered positive-weighted branch certificate

A=A85=(11,5,1) has 2772 nominal distinct ordered count-compatible prefixes, but exactly 1939 first reach A without previous stopping. Their exact P and Q masses are

pA=6059375/6115295232,
qA=6059375/23219011584.

Conditional on continuing, A has (P-error,Q-error,additional P-time,additional Q-time)
RA=(41/13824,569/576,69/64,167/144).

An independent ordered-word DFS relative to the shared inherited stop table counts 9 terminal suffix words and 8 terminal decision-state classes; stopping at A truncates 1939*9=17451 terminal histories. These integer history counts are never used as probability masses.

For B=(12,0,1), all 12 nominal prefixes first arrive, with

pB=48828125/725594112,
qB=48828125/362797056,
RB=(63/64,1/144,9/8,13/12).

Define positive exact coefficients

X=pA*RA[P-error]=248434375/84537841287168,
Y=qA*(1-RA[Q-error])=42415625/13374150672384,
E=pB*(1-RB[P-error])=48828125/46438023168,
H=qB*RB[Q-error]=48828125/52242776064.

The carrier preserves ordered labels, stopping decisions and exact nonnegative rational P/Q weights, a concrete positive-weighted BRC-style reuse. It neither encodes signed phase cancellation nor asserts a native X6 embedding.

## Feasible primal attaining the line for every real delta

At A stop and decide P with probability u; at B stop and decide Q with probability s; all other actions remain frozen. Here u ranges over the full real interval [0,1]. A occurs at time n=11 with a=5 while B occurs at n=12 with a=0. The zero count never decreases; B also cannot precede A because of time ordering. Thus the path cones are disjoint and the risk/time functions have *no u*s mixed terms*.

Relative to the stage84 baseline (u=0,s=s84),

Delta eP=-X*u+E*(s-s84),
Delta eQ=+Y*u-H*(s-s84).

Set s=s84+h85*u where

h85=(X+Y)/(E+H)=2677759/870400000.

Then both errors equal alpha84+eta85*u, because

eta85=-X+E*h85=Y-H*h85
     =478690625/1616786214617088>0.

Throughout 0<=u<=1 the probabilities are valid:

0<s84<=s<=s85=22950702493354427/41779200000000000<1.

Exact forward weighted propagation gives the endpoint differences

(tP-tQ) at u=0 =2358671366823186305/3725075438477770752>0,
(tP-tQ) at u=1 =2356622709392786305/3725075438477770752>0.

Disjoint cones make this difference affine, hence strictly positive for all real u in [0,1]. All occupied actions are Bellman minimizers, so tP+lambdaP*eP+lambdaQ*eQ=Droot and max(tP,tQ)=tP. Consequently tP=V84-Gamma85*eta85*u, meeting the global lower bound at every real delta=eta85*u. This proves the full continuum, not a finite grid.

## Right-end sharpness

Suppose alpha>alpha85 attained the same dual affine line. Since lambdaP and lambdaQ are strictly positive, equality would force both errors to equal alpha and every action with positive ordered-prefix mass to be Bellman minimizing. Exhaustive strict gaps exclude any other randomization. History-dependent mixtures within the A and B count fibers can be averaged into effective u,s in [0,1] because each fiber has identical likelihood ratio and suffix law. The disjoint-cone error balance then forces s=s84+h85*u and alpha=alpha84+eta85*u<=alpha85, a contradiction. Finite horizon gives a compact policy-performance set, preventing an unattained equality limit.

## Reproducibility and boundaries

The original predecessor proof is at dd8d3a05d2fde3d318d16591eff949fc2dd58ee9:research_notes/n14_aux_iid_affine_84_20261025/PROOF.en.md. Exact local Python standard-library Fraction code derive85.py and ordered-history DFS crosscheck85.py were executed successfully, including all 680 states, 1240 comparisons, independent-form DFS first-hit/suffix enumeration, and exact rational checks at u=0,1/97,1/7,1/2,17/23,96/97,1. They share the inherited action table and are two author-side checks, **not independent Driver review**. The local source code versions were derived from the stage84 file by precisely recorded edits; no native sample/physical correspondence is asserted.

Native control attempt: em_control_tasks -> CONTROL_QUOTA; em_session_start -> STATIC_READONLY_SCOPE_DENIED (operation_sent=false). Hence active Owner, current CLAIM, native Result and independent review remain unverified. This source note is deliberately author-level evidence only.

**Next unproved**: after setting A85 to immediate P, downward dual candidate K86=2268, state A86=(12,3,0), continue versus P. Compute first-hit masses, suffixes, cone intersections, exact balancing and new full interval; do not promote a candidate to a proved stage.
